prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: Students possess the competence to apply problem-oriented design, selection, and analysis methods for advanced algorithms and data structures.
Students have a fundamental understanding of the efficiency of algorithms and data structures.
Students have an advanced understanding of the structure and function of computers, especially microcontrollers, their different design concepts, and application possibilities.
Students are familiar with the development chain for processors and acquire the competence to select optimal processors/controllers for various applications.
Students have a basic, practical understanding of hardware-level programming and its specific features.

syllabus_topics: Advanced data structures and algorithms for trees and graphs with object-oriented implementation
Characteristics of efficient algorithms and associated data structures
Execution concepts (single-cycle, multi-cycle, pipelining, mixed concepts)
Computer development from instruction set to circuit design
teaching_methods: VU Programming, Algorithms and Data Structures 3 (VU Programmierung, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen 3)
VO Processor and Microcontroller Architecture (VO Prozessor- und Mikrocontrollerarchitektur)
